integration_limits: No collector, registry, admission, requirement planner or check registration; this module is uninstalled.
Source archives are build inputs, not produced artifacts, and cannot prove cloud_build_artifacts coverage.
StorageSourceManifest plans only the pinned manifest JSON object; referenced children are not parsed or planned.

Results.artifactManifest is rejected even with a URI fragment: no separate native generation field and no reviewed manifest URI grammar/traversal implementation. No artifact object generations are inferred from path globs or numArtifacts.

No stored log plan: logsBucket supplies a bucket/filename convention, not an immutable generation; logUrl is a Console URL. No log bucket inference from defaults, build ID, or options; no Cloud Logging querying.

No GCR, external registry, Git/Cloud Source Repository/connected repository, package upload result, buildStepImages, image index, or artifactRegistryPackage relationship support. Presence of artifactRegistryPackage on BuiltImage rejects that image until its native identity binding is reviewed.
No broad or complete surface coverage claim; partial plans and explicit unresolved relationships are returned.
Native metadata completeness, authenticated origin and freshness are caller obligations; the pure planner validates supplied relationships, not collection receipts.
Uninstalled: no registry, collector, engine check admission, server option validation, canonical catalog, or production hook changed.
Future caller must provide collected complete inventories and authenticated GET receipts; URL-keyed dicts are a pure adapter contract, not evidence provenance by themselves.
Future caller must establish a consistent capture window, retain source request IDs, and revalidate service state around revision/image capture to handle concurrent deployments.

Plans cover only explicitly selected services and positive-traffic/tagged revisions at capture time; not all project services, jobs, worker pools, historical inactive revisions or external source repositories.
Multi-container revisions fail closed: v1 singular imageDigest cannot prove all sidecar image bindings.
Only lowercase same-project pkg.dev Artifact Registry paths accepted; GCR domain mapping added by coordinator remains outside this planner until a shared-parser follow-up with fixtures.
At most 16 active revisions overall and 4 distinct images per plan; exceeding either raises ValueError without partial plan.
Reader must enforce existing manifest/layer/platform/byte/deadline and dual-detector completion contracts; a planned image is never a clean result.
Native revision image is deployable artifact identity; it does not establish source-code provenance or include external config, secrets, runtime-generated content or mounted data.

acceptance.note: Includes 18 GCR directed tests and 45 source-planner/inventory tests; proposals alone are not secret inspections.

root_follow_up.cloudrun: Installed through the existing image check; see docs/gcp-review/cloudrun-image-integration.json.
root_follow_up.cloudbuild: Independent output-manifest and stored-log adapters are now installed; see followup-content-integration.json and cloudbuild-log-integration.json. The initial generic pure planner itself is not a content reader.
